fusions.name: Stampede Gust
fusions.desc: A gust deals 14 wind damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Steady Kick
fusions.desc: A quick kick that deals 5 blunt damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Ride
fusions.desc: You move 10% faster, and your wind resistance rises by 8%.
